newsitem.title: USA: 10 injured on American Airlines flight.
newsitem.headline: 10 injured on American Airlines flight.

text.p: Ten passengers were injured on Thursday when an American Airlines flight from Seattle to New York ran into turbulence and the plane had to be diverted to Denver, a spokeswoman for the airline said.
"The injuries were bruises, lacerations and possible concussions," said AMR Corp.s' American Airlines spokeswoman Andrea Rader. None of the injuries was life threatening, she said.
The injured passengers were taken to two local hospitals.
Flight 242 hit turbulance over southwest North Dakota, Rader said.
The airline was inspecting the Boeing 757 for damage, and American was sending in another plane from Dallas to continue the flight to New York's JFK Airport Thursday evening, she said.
The pilot decided to divert the plane to Denver International Airport because of the injuries but the plane did not have to make an emergency landing, an airport spokesman said.
